user.title: Connect to Runsten
user.description: Sign in with your Runsten account at my.runsten.app, or paste an access token: for an instance you host yourself, or to connect without signing in.

token.title: Connect with an access token
token.description: Paste a personal access token of your Runsten account: in Runsten, Settings, API access, New access token. It only reads your data, and you can revoke it there.

data_description.url: Keep {default_url}, unless you host Runsten yourself: then your instance's address.

reauth_confirm.title: Runsten refused the access token
reauth_confirm.description: The access token of {url} was revoked or has expired. Paste a new one: in Runsten, Settings, API access.

reauth_oauth.title: Sign in to Runsten again
reauth_oauth.description: Runsten no longer lets Home Assistant read this account: it was disconnected in Runsten, under Settings, Connected apps, or not used for 30 days. Sign in again with the same account.

error.invalid_auth: Runsten refused the access token: it may be revoked or expired.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Runsten at this address.
error.invalid_token: A Runsten access token starts with rst_.
error.invalid_url: This is not a valid address.

abort.wrong_account: This is another Runsten account: sign in with the account of this entry.
abort.missing_configuration: Signing in with Runsten is not available.
abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: Signing in with Runsten is not available.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Runsten's sign-in page could not be prepared in time.
abort.no_url_available: Home Assistant has no URL to return to after the sign-in.
abort.user_rejected_authorize: Signing in with Runsten was refused: {error}
abort.oauth_error: Runsten's answer to the sign-in is not valid.
abort.oauth_failed: Runsten's tokens could not be obtained.
abort.oauth_timeout: Runsten's tokens could not be obtained in time.

data_description.track_location: A device tracker for each vehicle, at its latest known position. Turned off, the trackers are removed.

rate_limited.message: Too many requests to Runsten with this access token; retrying later.

free_plan.title: Runsten Free reads your vehicles every {minutes} minutes
free_plan.description:
Your Runsten account is on Free: its vehicles are read every {minutes} minutes, so their values change here only that often, and an automation may run late. Plus reads them in real time, every minute while driving or charging.

You can ignore this message: the integration works the same.
